text: Life is 10% what happens to you and 90% how you react to it.
author: Charles Swindoll

archive.text: Think where man's glory most begins and ends, and say my glory was I had such friends.

archive.text: When you discover your mission, you will feel its demand. It will fill you with enthusiasm and a burning desire to get to work on it.

archive.author: Plato

archive.text: They alone live who live for others, the rest are more dead than alive.
archive.author: Swami Vivekananda

archive.text: The two most important days in your life are the day you are born and the day you find out why.
archive.author: Mark Twain

archive.text: At the center of your being you have the answer; you know who you are and you know what you want.
archive.author: Lao Tzu
